settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var other_keys: List[str] = []
  var other_vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
    else if k == "level"
      level = copy v
    else
      var found = -1
      for j in range(0, other_keys.len())
        if other_keys[j] == k
          found = j
      if found >= 0
        other_vals[found] = copy v
      else
        other_keys.append(copy k)
        other_vals.append(copy v)
  var res = [copy mode, copy level]
  for w in other_vals
    res.append(copy w)
  res
